$:set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p terminal/tasks/fishFry
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry-pillow-venv
/tmp/fishfry-pillow-venv/bin/pip -q install Pillow
curl -fLsS --max-time 30 'https://assets.katomcdn.com/q_auto%2Cf_auto/v1637700341/products/080/080-APZS12/080-apzs12.jpg' -o /tmp/fishfry-source.jpg
/tmp/fishfry-pillow-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
source = Image.open('/tmp/fishfry-source.jpg').convert('RGB')
if source.size != (1476, 1536):
    source = source.resize((1476, 1536), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(source)
draw.line((915, 55, 560, 55), fill=(0, 0, 0), width=8)
draw.polygon([(560, 55), (596, 37), (596, 73)], fill=(0, 0, 0))
annotated = Path('/tmp/fishfry-annotated.jpg')
source.save(annotated, quality=95)
result = Image.open(annotated).transpose(Image.Transpose.ROTATE_270)
target = Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png')
result.save(target)
print('BUILT', target, result.size, target.stat().st_size)
PY
TARGET='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png'
CONTENT=$(base64 -w0 "$TARGET")
gh api --method PUT "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$TARGET" -f message='Add rotated fish-fry pizza-screen image' -f content="$CONTENT" --jq '{commit: .commit.sha, path: .content.path, size: .content.size}'
gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$TARGET" --jq '{path: .path, size: .size, sha: .sha}'
